name: Feature request
about: Propose an improvement to the bouquet or postcard experience

## Problem

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way?

## Proposed change

Describe the experience you want. How does it fit a surprise bouquet that can be shared as the same arrangement?

## Alternatives and trade-offs

Include alternatives you considered and any effects on existing bouquet links, keyboard/touch access, reduced motion, or self-hosting.
